entries.summary: CRS Rule: Default EPSG:4326 for input/output; EPSG:32734 for Cape Town analysis
entries.detail: All external data flows through EPSG:4326 (WGS84). Internal analysis for distance/buffer operations may use EPSG:32734 (UTM 34S for Cape Town). Frontend sends lat/lng, backend returns GeoJSON in 4326. This is enforced in app/config.py and spatial_utils.py.

Frontend follows module-per-feature organization: src/modules/services/, src/modules/transport/, src/modules/safety/, src/modules/environment/. Each module contains its own components, state, and API calls. Shared components live in src/components/Common/.

entries.summary: Beta stage: strict CI quality gates required before merge
entries.detail: Project is in Beta (CI-gated) stage. All PRs must pass: frontend (npm run lint, type-check, build, audit), backend (ruff check app/, pip-audit --strict, pytest), E2E (npm run test:e2e for UI changes), Docker (compose build for infra changes).

entries.summary: Data sources from City of Cape Town Open Data Portal
entries.detail: All datasets come from City of Cape Town Open Data Portal (ArcGIS MapServer). Attributions documented in DATA_SOURCES.md. Key datasets: Informal Settlements, MyCiTi Transport Network, Zoning/Land Use, Safety/Crime Statistics.

entries.summary: Admin endpoints are unprotected when ADMIN_API_KEY not set
entries.detail: app/dependencies.py allows access to admin endpoints when settings.ADMIN_API_KEY is empty. This is acceptable for local dev but should be treated as a security risk in production. Recommend adding a CI policy or runtime check to enforce ADMIN_API_KEY for protected branches and production deployments.

npx tsc --noEmit produced 18 errors in files including DataStatusPanel.tsx, ExportPanel.tsx, MapView.tsx, RealtimePanel.tsx and repositories/GeoDataRepository.ts. These block CI type-check step and should be fixed as a priority for type-safety and maintainability.

entries.summary: Ruff found a fixable unused import
entries.detail: ruff check reported an unused import 'settings' in app/api/advanced_analysis_api.py (fixable). Generated patch: patches/0001-remove-unused-import.patch
Collected 157 tests across tests/ including integration tests which may require a running PostGIS database. Plan test runs accordingly and consider tagging long-running integration tests.

entries.summary: Site suitability module uses placeholder evaluators with TODOs
entries.detail: app/spatial_analysis/site_suitability.py contains multiple TODOs indicating missing PostGIS wiring for flood_zones, biodiversity, wetlands, open_spaces, zoning, road network, myciti_stops, urban_edge. These represent key missing features for suitability analysis and should be prioritized with tests and a migration plan.
